selected.goal: Add focused regression coverage proving run locks are cleaned up or recoverable after an interrupted process.
selected.why_now: evidence: .converge/artifacts/self-improvement-loop/epochs/001/observe/findings.json reports high-severity missing run-lock interruption coverage, and the probe `find tests -maxdepth 1 -name '*.test.ts' | sort` found no run-lock cleanup or interrupted-process test file. This is a production lifecycle gap rather than cosmetic/DX churn; the durable metrics and touched-files ledgers are absent on disk for this run, so no repeated last-epoch pattern was observed.
non_goals: Do not change public CLI commands or flags.
Do not refactor unrelated run, DAG, or seed execution paths.
Do not weaken existing lock semantics; cover the interruption behavior before implementation changes.
implementation_steps: Add a focused Vitest test that creates an isolated playbook run and leaves or simulates an interrupted run lock.
Assert a subsequent run can clean up or recover from the interrupted lock without manual deletion.
If the regression fails, make the minimal run lock cleanup change in the run or CLI lifecycle path.
Run the focused regression and existing build checks.
selected.rollback_plan: Revert the new run-lock regression test and any minimal lifecycle cleanup change together; existing run behavior and builds should return to the prior state.
